statement: The United States military will conduct at least one additional publicly reported airstrike on targets inside Iranian territory between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-13.
resolution: True if U.S. Central Command, the Pentagon, or a major wire service (Reuters, AP, BBC, Al Jazeera) reports a new U.S. strike on Iranian soil between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-13; otherwise false.

statement: Between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-20, NATO will hold or announce formal Article 4 consultations in response to the reported Russian missile breach of Polish airspace.
resolution: True if NATO, a NATO member government, Reuters, or AP reports that Article 4 consultations were formally requested or held over this specific incident between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-20; otherwise false.

statement: Between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-27, at least one additional commercial or military vessel will be struck by a drone, missile, or mine in the Persian Gulf, Red Sea, Strait of Hormuz, or eastern Mediterranean in connection with the Iran conflict.
resolution: True if a major wire service (Reuters, AP) or Lloyds List reports a new vessel strike in these waters tied to the Iran conflict between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-27; otherwise false.

statement: The confirmed death toll from the magnitude 6.8 Uto, Japan earthquake will exceed 40 between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-14.
resolution: True if Japanese government authorities, NHK, or a major wire service reports a confirmed death toll above 40 for this earthquake between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-14; otherwise false.

statement: Between 2026-07-30 and 2026-09-15, a U.S. federal agency or critical-infrastructure operator will be publicly confirmed as compromised via the Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center hard-coded credential flaw CVE-2026-20316.
resolution: True if CISA, a federal agency, or a major outlet (Reuters, Hacker News, BleepingComputer) confirms a specific victim compromised through CVE-2026-20316 between 2026-07-30 and 2026-09-15; otherwise false.

statement: Meta Platforms stock will close lower than its 2026-07-30 closing price at least once more between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-06.
resolution: True if Meta Platforms common stock records at least one additional daily close below its 2026-07-30 close on any trading day between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-06; otherwise false.

statement: The U.S. Senate will vote to confirm Todd Blanche as Attorney General between 2026-07-30 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if the U.S. Senate holds a floor vote confirming Todd Blanche as Attorney General, as reported by a major outlet, between 2026-07-30 and 2026-09-30; otherwise false.

statement: A militant group will publicly claim responsibility for the attack on the northwest Pakistan police post that killed 11 officers, between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-13.
resolution: True if a group such as Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan or an affiliate issues a public claim of responsibility reported by a major outlet between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-13; otherwise false.

statement: Confirmed fatalities from the current Crete, Greece wildfire event will exceed 5 between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-20.
resolution: True if Greek civil protection authorities or a major wire service reports more than 5 confirmed deaths from this wildfire event between 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-20; otherwise false.
